tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: The minimal inhibitory concentrations (MICs) and minimal bactericidal concentrations (MBCs) of DMPC-10A and DMPC-10B against selected microorganisms. MICs of antibiotics (gentamicin, vancomycin and norfloxacin) were tested as well.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Effect of MgCl2, CaCl2, NaCl and fetal bovine serum (FBS) on the antimicrobial activity of DMPC-10B against S. aureus (NCTC 10788) and E. coli (NCTC 10418).

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Synergistic effect of DMPC-10B with gentamicin and norfloxacin against the growth of K. pneumoniae (ATCC 43816), K. pneumoniae (ATCC BAA 1705), and K. pneumoniae (ATCC BAA 2342). The MICs are shown as the combined MIC/individual MIC. The fractional inhibitory concentration index (FICI) was calculated and interpreted as synergistic for FICI ≤ 0.5, additive for 0.5 < FICI ≤ 4.0, and antagonistic for FICI > 4.0.
